title: REEL: Learning to Retrieve, Evaluate, and Evolve Visual Memory for Any Long-Horizon Multi-Shot Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory-based long-video generation aims to combine user control with long-range visual consistency. We organize this process into three functional components: a planner, an adapter, and a generator. Representative multi-shot systems couple memory to generator-specific interfaces or use predefined agent workflows, rather than independently training a memory policy for cross-shot objectives. We introduce REEL, a general-purpose visual-memory planner. Through a unified tool interface, REEL learns to retrieve references, create missing visual evidence, and update persistent memory. Backend-specific adapters translate its evidence plans into supported conditioning inputs, allowing the same policy to guide different black-box video generators. To train REEL, we construct two high-quality datasets, REEL-SFT-4k and REEL-RL-1k, covering diverse interaction patterns and prompt types. tldr: 提出通用视觉记忆规划器REEL，通过统一工具接口学习检索参考、生成缺失视觉证据和更新持久记忆，并借助后端适配器使同一记忆策略能够驱动不同的黑盒视频生成器，实现兼顾用户控制与长程视觉一致性的多镜头长视频生成。
en_tdlr: REEL introduces a general-purpose visual-memory planner that learns to retrieve references, create missing visual evidence, and update persistent memory via a unified tool interface, with backend-specific adapters enabling the same policy to guide different black-box video generators for long-horizon multi-shot video generation.
